dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #...So scary! Terrifying! If it wasn't for {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, I don't know what would've happened to me.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: But why? Why would monsters appear in such a beautiful place? Is it really that...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Nope! Not gonna keep thinking about that. It wasn't easy for me to forge a life for myself here.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: If you find another page, or want to meditate... The book hasn't moved. But please, be careful.
